summary_en: This study tests padeliporfin vascular targeted photodynamic therapy (VTP) in people with locally advanced, unresectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The treatment is placed through a catheter into an artery near the pancreas, with a balloon inflated for a total of 10 minutes during light illumination, and the study escalates light doses of 200, 400 and 600 mW/cm. Frequency beyond a single dose is not stated. The study is a Phase 1 trial that measures safety and preliminary efficacy and aims to find the maximum tolerated light dose and/or recommended phase 2 dose.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la terapia fotodinámica dirigida a vasos con padeliporfina (VTP) en personas con adenocarcinoma de páncreas localmente avanzado e irresecable. El tratamiento se aplica mediante un catéter colocado en una arteria cercana al páncreas, con un balón inflado durante un total de 10 minutos mientras se ilumina; el estudio aumenta las dosis de luz de 200, 400 y 600 mW/cm. La frecuencia más allá de una dosis única no se indica. Es un estudio de Fase 1 que mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar, y busca determinar la dosis máxima de luz tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years and older who can give written informed consent
Stage III pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with an unresectable tumor in the head or uncinate process
ECOG performance status of 1 or less and life expectancy of at least 6 months
Target artery tumor contact and artery diameter within the stated limits
not_for: Previous radiotherapy to the pancreas for pancreatic cancer
Cystic component of 25% or more of the tumor volume
Congestive heart failure or myocardial infarction or ischemic event within the past 6 months
